title: e-means · 可交互的聚类算法研究主页

description.zh: 用 Lloyd k-means 与 e-means 的同步可播放聚类过程和 MSE 曲线建立直觉，再衔接公式推导、消融实验、结果地图及可调参数的 Playground；预览为官方讲解视频海报，并非整页截图。
description.en: A research explainer that opens with a synchronized, playable Lloyd-versus-e-means clustering comparison and loss curves, then connects equations, ablations, results maps and a parameterized playground. Preview is the official explainer-video poster, not a site screenshot.

zh: 设计需要直观解释算法行为、迭代收敛或性能对比的科研项目主页。
希望把静态结果曲线升级为可交互实验，让读者自行观察参数影响。
en: Designing a research site that explains algorithm behavior, iterative convergence or performance differences.
Turning static result plots into interactive demonstrations where readers can explore parameter changes.

zh: 让双栏对照动画与同一时间轴上的误差曲线共同承担首屏论证，尽量减少读者在图表之间来回猜测。
把入门演示与深入交互分层：首屏可快速观看，独立 Playground 开放数据规模、簇数、轮数与随机种子等控制。
按“核心主张 → 可视化直觉 → 更新规则与机制 → 实验和消融 → 代码/论文”组织长篇技术内容。
en: Pair synchronized side-by-side animations with loss curves in the opening evidence, reducing the cognitive gap between motion and metrics.
Separate a lightweight first-impression demo from the configurable playground with data size, cluster count, epochs and seeds.
Sequence claim → visual intuition → algorithmic mechanics → evaluations and ablations → code/paper.

zh: 官方视频海报不是网页首屏截图，更不能代表可实际操作的 Playground；交互要在作者网站核验。
网站报告的加速幅度由任务、硬件及对比基线决定；读者不能把作者报告当作本站独立复现。
上游 MIT 许可证仅覆盖 JavaScript，文字、图像和视频没有相同的复制授权；仅做来源明确的链接式参考。
en: The official video poster is not a screenshot or proof that the playground works; verify interactions on the original site.
Reported acceleration depends on workload, hardware and baselines; the catalog has not independently reproduced the results.
The site's MIT license covers JavaScript only, not text, images or video; this entry uses attributed links rather than copying media.

insight.zh: 这个主页的亮点不是单张漂亮图，而是把“算法比基线快多少”转化为读者能直接观察和操纵的过程：同步聚类动画解释发生了什么，loss 曲线解释收敛到哪里，Playground 再让读者验证不同设置下的行为。
insight.en: The strength is not a decorative figure but a manipulable explanation of the speed–quality claim: synchronized clustering animations show what changes, loss curves show where it converges, and the playground exposes configurable conditions.

zh: 首屏使用醒目的定量主张，并将 Lloyd/e-means 双栏动态聚类与同步 MSE 曲线并列，视觉上先回答“更快且精度如何”。
正文不是堆图，而是把经典 k-means、EMA 更新、scaling laws、dead-cluster revival 等机制逐节解释，配合公式与对应的图形证据。
Playground、Results Map、视频、Paper、Code 分成不同入口：快速体验与实验细查互不干扰。
整体采用克制的留白、少量强调色和信息层级，视觉编码与算法对照一致。
en: Lead with a quantified claim, then align Lloyd/e-means animations and the live MSE trace to immediately clarify speed and convergence.
Structure the long-form explanation around k-means, EMA updates, scaling laws and dead-cluster revival, pairing each mechanism with relevant evidence.
Separate Playground, Results Map, video, Paper and Code so quick exploration and deep checking have distinct paths.
Use restrained whitespace, a small consistent palette and clear hierarchy, preserving color identity across comparisons.

zh: 先选一个最能体现核心贡献的可视化变量，设计“基线 vs 方法”同步播放与统一指标轴。
首屏只展示能够即时理解的最小演示；完整参数选择、复现实验和数据集切换放进独立 Playground。
将论文阅读路线拆成“主张 → 直觉 → 机制 → 评估 → 复现”；每个关键结论附近提供原始实验口径或论文锚点。
为所有图、视频、数据表提供论文和代码来源链接，并在移动端控制计算量与交互复杂度。
en: Choose one decisive behavior, with synchronized baseline–method playback and a shared metric axis.
Use a minimal immediately legible hero demo; move full parameter control, reruns and dataset variation into a dedicated playground.
Organize claim → intuition → mechanism → evaluation → reproducibility, keeping evidence near the claim it supports.
Link media and results to source context, and bound browser compute and interaction complexity on mobile.

zh: 此条目使用作者原仓库中的视频海报作为外部预览，不是网页首屏截图；动画、Playground 和结果地图仍需从原站打开。
页面列出的 10–45× GPU 与 8–15× CPU 等数值属于作者在特定基线与规模下报告的结果；本站未运行复现或独立验证。
上游 README 明确 MIT 仅覆盖网站 JavaScript，不包括文字、图表、照片或视频；不得直接复制海报和网页素材到其他项目。
en: The preview links the author-hosted video poster, not a first-viewport screenshot; animations, playground and results map must be explored on the live website.
The site's 10–45× GPU and 8–15× CPU claims are upstream benchmark reports under specific setups, not independently reproduced by this catalog.
The upstream README explicitly limits MIT to site JavaScript and excludes text, figures, images and video; do not copy the media into another project.
